headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Positives: • Company’s strategy is to build, own, and operate India’s leading network of tank terminals and distribution facilities. • Proposed integration of Tristar Holdings Limited into Aegis Logistics marks the most significant milestone in the company’s corporate history. • Gas distribution volumes grew significantly. • LPG Distribution Volumes: Reached 2.41 lakh MT, growing 25% yoy.

Negatives: • Sourcing Volumes: Reported at 0.9 lakh MT for the quarter, seeing lower normalized volumes due to the expiration of specific contracts. ` ` ` The content of this document has been derived from Kotak Securities PCG research report.
